body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 874ced7e09987793d01b84b4be4a8f4ec9f51454 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (with one owed item, below).

**What looks good**
- No existing golden, `.nc`/`.cl` file or snapshot PNG changed; the only golden changes are 6 new files in `crates/post/tests/golden/ream/`.
- G85 blocks are right by RS-274/NGC (R plane, Z, F, G99 as the post already uses for G81, G80 cancel). Sinumerik keeps its ISO-dialect cycle words (G81..G89, as its other cycles), so a G85 there matches the script's own convention.
- Expanded form (Heidenhain, TinyG, Carvera, tormach-lathe) feeds out at F (`G01 ... Z+2 F150`), never a rapid out of the hole, and returns to the same R height as the canned form.
- Motion: Ream chain is plunge then Feed back to R at the plunge feed, dwell dropped, so simulation/verify read the feed-out as cutting. Bore-door refusals (tool must fit, stepped hole) and radial refusal are pinned.
- The new unknown-cycle `else` refusal cannot refuse a cycle that posted before: every kind the engine emits (SPOT, DRILL, PECK, DEEP, TAP, BORE, BACKBORE; FloatingTap is sent as TAP) is mapped ahead of it in each post. Sinker/wire/plasma refuse by name (pinned).
- Old project files load unchanged (new spelling `"ream"` only); command + MCP path pinned; provenance comments name NIST IR 6556 / LinuxCNC; clean-room; no unwrap/expect added; decision file present.

**Results merged with main** (locally; the runner job stayed queued 15+ min behind another review, cancelled)
- camcraft-post and camcraft-cl, all suites: pass, 0 failed (post `ream_cycle` 5/5, every existing golden byte-identical).
- motion lib `drilling`: 42 pass. app `ream_cycle`: 3/3. ui `cycle_combo`: 2/2, structural: 9/9.
- clippy `-D warnings` on cl, post, motion, app, ui with `--all-targets`: clean.

**Requested before merge**
- None blocking.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
1. UI change (Cycle dropdown gains "Ream") has no before/after screenshots in the body: owed per the UI-PR rule.
2. fanuc-lathe writes G85 for REAM, same word it already uses for BORE; unpinned (#1481). Acceptable as it is the existing lathe feed-in/feed-out word, but not verified on a control.
3. All goldens are mapping records, not control-verified; the post-side unknown-cycle `else` is unreachable by a test.
4. Not exercised: full batch tier, Windows-only arms (diff has none), real control output.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
